items.title: APT37 hackers abuse Google Find Hub in Android data-wiping attacks
items.description: North Korean hackers from the KONNI activity cluster are abusing Google's Find Hub tool to track their targets' GPS positions and trigger remote factory resets of Android devices. [...]

items.title: OWASP Highlights Supply Chain Risks in New Top 10 List
items.description: Security misconfiguration jumped to second place while injection vulnerabilities dropped, as organizations improve defenses against traditional coding flaws.
